mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM products p JOIN product_seasons ps ON p.id = ps.product_id JOIN seasons s ON ps.season_id = s.id WHERE ( s.start_month <= s.end_month AND #{month} BETWEEN s.start_month AND s.end_month ) OR ( s.start_month> s.end_month AND ( #{month} >= s.start_month OR #{month} <= s.end_month ) ) ORDER BY p.recommendation_score DESC LIMIT 4
